nodes.statement: A siamese network is then represented by two identical deep ConvNets trained using pairs of labelled inputs, where one possible loss function (called pairwise loss) minimises the distance between embedded features of the same class and maximises the distance between embedded features of different classes, as follows: J_1^s( x_i,x_j, & theta_f ) = delta(y_i-y_j)\| f^(1)(x_i, theta_f) - f^(2)(x_j, theta_f) \|_2 - \\ & (1 - delta(y_i-y_j))\| f^(1)(x_i, theta_f) - f^(2)(x_j, theta_f) \|_2, where delta(.) is the Dirac delta function and f^(1)(x,theta_f) is constrained to equal to f^(2)(x,theta_f).
